suppress.notes: Suppression of Spring Framework 6.2.19 vulnerabilities for unused components in Enterprise Command Center: - CVE-2026-47884: XsltView SSRF/RCE (no XsltView or view-rendering controllers in application) - CVE-2026-47890: SSE view fragments stream corruption (no SSE or view fragments used) - CVE-2026-47891: Aalto XML processor in WebFlux (WebFlux not used; application runs on Tomcat with Jackson) - CVE-2026-47892: WebFlux functional endpoints header predicate bypass (functional WebFlux not deployed) - CVE-2026-59313: Spring MVC functional SSE stream corruption (functional SSE endpoints not used) - CVE-2026-59283: SpEL SimpleEvaluationContext safety guard bypass (untrusted SpEL expressions not evaluated) - CVE-2026-47885: WebFlux PartEventHttpMessageReader maxPartSize (WebFlux multipart reader not used) - CVE-2026-47886: User-supplied SpEL DoS (no user SpEL evaluated) - CVE-2026-47888: RSocket SETUP frame memory leak (RSocket transport not used) - CVE-2026-47889: WebFlux Jetty 12 sameSite cookie (Jetty and WebFlux not used; application runs on Tomcat) - CVE-2026-47893: WebFlux WebSocket header exposure (WebFlux WebSocket not used) - CVE-2026-59282: Data binding user property paths (no untrusted user property path binding) - CVE-2026-47883: UrlHandlerFilter open redirect (UrlHandlerFilter not configured) - CVE-2026-47887: UrlFileNameViewController (UrlFileNameViewController not configured) - CVE-2026-59281: HTML escaping bypass in Errors instance (application returns JSON, no HTML error rendering) - CVE-2026-59280: FreeMarker path traversal (FreeMarker template engine not included or used) - CVE-2026-59314: Content-Disposition HTTP response splitting (Content-Disposition not generated from untrusted input)
CPE-level suppression for Spring Framework 6.2.19 matching CVEs
